svg.title: Figure 14. The Tree of Life (interactive)
svg.desc: The Tree of Life: ten circles in three columns joined by twenty-two lines. Top to bottom: Kether, Crown; Chokmah, Wisdom, and Binah, Understanding; Chesed, Mercy, and Geburah, Severity; Tiphareth, Beauty; Netzach, Victory, and Hod, Splendour; Yesod, Foundation; Malkuth, Kingdom. Each path carries a Hebrew letter. The paths are numbered 11 to 32, from Aleph between Kether and Chokmah to Tav between Yesod and Malkuth.

g.aria-label: Path 11: Aleph, Air, 0 The Fool
Path 12: Beth, Mercury, I The Magician
Path 13: Gimel, Moon, II The High Priestess
Path 14: Daleth, Venus, III The Empress
Path 15: Heh, Aries, IV The Emperor
Path 16: Vav, Taurus, V The Hierophant
Path 17: Zayin, Gemini, VI The Lovers
Path 18: Cheth, Cancer, VII The Chariot
Path 19: Teth, Leo, VIII Strength
Path 20: Yod, Virgo, IX The Hermit
Path 21: Kaph, Jupiter, X Wheel of Fortune
Path 22: Lamed, Libra, XI Justice
Path 23: Mem, Water, XII The Hanged Man
Path 24: Nun, Scorpio, XIII Death
Path 25: Samekh, Sagittarius, XIV Temperance
Path 26: Ayin, Capricorn, XV The Devil
Path 27: Peh, Mars, XVI The Tower
Path 28: Tzaddi, Aquarius, XVII The Star
Path 29: Qoph, Pisces, XVIII The Moon
Path 30: Resh, Sun, XIX The Sun
Path 31: Shin, Fire (and Spirit), XX Judgement
Path 32: Tav, Saturn (and Earth), XXI The World
1. Kether, Crown. Planet or sphere: Primum Mobile
2. Chokmah, Wisdom. Planet or sphere: The zodiac
3. Binah, Understanding. Planet or sphere: Saturn
4. Chesed, Mercy. Planet or sphere: Jupiter
5. Geburah, Severity. Planet or sphere: Mars
6. Tiphareth, Beauty. Planet or sphere: Sun
7. Netzach, Victory. Planet or sphere: Venus
8. Hod, Splendour. Planet or sphere: Mercury
9. Yesod, Foundation. Planet or sphere: Moon
10. Malkuth, Kingdom. Planet or sphere: The elements

svg.text: GRECO ARCANA · THE SOLITARY STUDY · ORIGINAL EDUCATIONAL DIAGRAM
